date_policy: Applicability dates delimit the study, not a claim of evidence coverage. Dates are inclusive; null until means open-ended.

lenses.name: Territorial recognition
lenses.definition: Ukraine has sovereignty over all its internationally recognized territory; annexation has no legal recognition.
lenses.positive: Ukraine has sovereignty over all its internationally recognized territory; annexation has no legal recognition.
lenses.negative: Recognizes Russian annexation or denies Ukrainian sovereignty over that territory.
lenses.boundary: Generic sovereignty language is insufficient; distinguish legal recognition from temporary de facto control.
lenses.no_stance_rule: No attributable stance on this exact proposition is not a neutral score.

lenses.name: Russian troop withdrawal
lenses.definition: Russian forces should withdraw from all internationally recognized Ukrainian territory.
lenses.positive: Russian forces should withdraw from all internationally recognized Ukrainian territory.
lenses.negative: Explicitly endorses continued Russian military control of that territory.
lenses.boundary: Calls for a ceasefire or negotiations alone are not opposition.
lenses.no_stance_rule: No attributable stance on this exact proposition is not a neutral score.

lenses.name: Military assistance to Ukraine
lenses.definition: Supports external military assistance to Ukraine, with type, recipient and conditions preserved.
lenses.positive: Supports external military assistance to Ukraine, with type, recipient and conditions preserved.
lenses.boundary: Humanitarian aid is distinct; preserve restrictions on weapons, use and deployment.
lenses.no_stance_rule: No attributable stance on this exact proposition is not a neutral score.

lenses.name: Sanctions against Russia
lenses.definition: Supports specified restrictive measures against Russia because of its actions in Ukraine.
lenses.positive: Supports specified restrictive measures against Russia because of its actions in Ukraine.
lenses.boundary: Separate adoption, maintenance and removal conditions; economic hardship alone is not a stance.
lenses.no_stance_rule: No attributable stance on this exact proposition is not a neutral score.

lenses.name: Responsibility for the February 2022 full-scale invasion
lenses.definition: Attributes responsibility for the February 2022 full-scale invasion to the Russian state.
lenses.positive: Attributes responsibility for the February 2022 full-scale invasion to the Russian state.
lenses.negative: Explicitly rejects attribution of responsibility to the Russian state.
lenses.boundary: Not applicable before 24 February 2022; preserve causal qualifications and attribution.
lenses.no_stance_rule: No attributable stance on this exact proposition is not a neutral score.
